setup.title: First run
setup.description: There is nobody in zorko yet. Create an administrator — they will set up projects and add people.

issues.title: Issues
issues.truncated: There are too many issues in this period — the most frequent are shown. Narrow the period or the search.

search.placeholder: Search: browser.name:Chrome release:shop{'@'}1.4.2 or words from the title

empty.title: No errors
empty.description: There were no events in this period. If the project is not connected yet, take the DSN from its settings.
empty.filtered: Nothing found — try another search or period

issue.title: Issue
issue.eventGone: Event not found: full records are kept for 30 days and no more than 100 per minute

events.note: The counter includes every crash; the list shows stored full records (up to 100 per minute, 30 days).

event.libraryFrames: {n} more library frame | {n} more library frames

org.emptyAdmin: Create an organization, then a project — and get a DSN to connect the SDK.
org.emptyMember: Ask an administrator to create an organization and a project.
org.deleteDescription: All its projects, keys and issues will be deleted. Events in ClickHouse expire on their own in 30 days.

project.title: Projects
project.deleteDescription: Its keys and issues will be deleted; errors sent with the old DSN will be rejected.

key.title: Keys (DSN)
key.empty: No keys — create one to get a DSN
key.label: Label
key.rateLimitHint: Spam protection, per ingest replica. 0 — no limit
key.originsHint: Hosts or masks separated by spaces or new lines: shop.mechta.kz, *.mdev.kz. Empty — any
key.deleteDescription: Apps with this DSN will stop sending errors.

sdk.title: How to connect
sdk.description: Regular Sentry libraries — only the DSN changes.
sdk.buildHint: During the build the plugin uploads source maps to zorko and removes .map files so they do not reach the site. CI needs one variable, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN — an organization CI token (Projects → CI tokens).
sdk.buildCli: Without the plugin — the same steps as commands after the build:

maps.title: Source maps
maps.description: Source map bundles from CI and fetched from the site. A bundle is deleted automatically after 30 days without errors.
maps.emptyHint: Connect the build plugin — the «Build: source maps» tab above.
maps.deleteDescription: New errors from this build will no longer be shown with original code. Errors already received will not change.

siteFetch.title: Source maps from the site
siteFetch.description: A fallback: when there is no source map from CI, zorko fetches it from the site. Each address is checked no more often than the interval, after success or failure.
siteFetch.enabled: Fetch source maps from the site
siteFetch.enabledHint: While off, zorko never requests the site
siteFetch.hostsHint: Hosts separated by spaces or new lines. Empty — none
siteFetch.headerSet: A value is set — leave empty to keep it

tokens.title: CI tokens
tokens.description: For uploading source maps and releases from the build. A token works only for this organization.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.onceDescription: It will not be shown again: zorko stores only a fingerprint. Lost it — delete it and create a new one.
tokens.usage: Put it into the CI variable SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN — the zorko address and the organization are already inside.
tokens.deleteDescription: Builds with this token will stop uploading source maps right away.

users.title: People
users.adminHint: An administrator manages projects, keys and people; a member only views
users.selfHint: You cannot remove your own administrator rights or disable yourself
users.deleteDescription: They will no longer be able to sign in.

apiError.not_authorized: Wrong username or password, or the session has expired
apiError.login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts — wait a minute
apiError.usr_self_change: You cannot delete, disable or demote yourself
apiError.sourcemaps_disabled: Source maps are not configured on the server

problem.title: Source maps were not applied to {n} frame | Source maps were not applied to {n} frames

code.no_debug_id_no_release: the error has no build id and no release — upload source maps with the plugin
code.map_not_found: no source map uploaded for this file
code.position_not_in_map: this line is not in the source map
code.storage_unavailable: the source map storage did not respond
code.site_disabled: fetching from the site is off
code.site_host_not_allowed: the site is not in the allowed list
code.site_address_blocked: the site address is internal (localhost, 169.254…) — always forbidden
code.site_timeout: the site did not respond in time
code.site_no_sourcemap_url: the file has no source map link
